cells.gaps: No share or count of primary schools entering data: the 2024 presentation gives 11,709,830 pupils on the platform, a pupil figure with no level named and no school count, and the only schools fact is the experimental launch of 2017. Kept disagrees: marks, averages and teachers' observations in 2024 (routine) against first-year primary enrolment through the parents' space in May 2025 (enrolment), which parents enter and not schools; daily management of absences is held only as a 2017 intention. DZA-001 is from the excluded source and sets nothing. Plan and finance not stated; no dated event in the twelve months to the as-at.
cells.note: Past its 2017 experiment: by 2024 the ministry's platform held marks for 11.7 million pupils with accounts for school staff and teachers, and in May 2025 first-year primary enrolment ran only through the system. Stage 4 needs more than half of primary schools entering attendance or results on a share or a count with its total, and no school figure has been found.
